seed_geometry.note: uniform downscale + translation only; identical for every cell of every K3 sheet (all cells share the seed geometry)

native_alpha_box_method: Union of alpha>=128 boxes, identical convention to frozen alpha_box; native dimensions exceed its 512x512 input restriction.

breath.spectral_method: scipy.signal.periodogram, constant detrend, boxcar; largest non-DC bin; one-cycle finite-window diagnostic only
breath.rest_minima_definition: Raw local minima within the bottom 5% of the full chest-width range; ignores small fluctuations on expanded plateaus.
breath.full_breath_definition: Consecutive rest minima enclosing at least 90% of the measured chest-width range.
breath.selection_reason: Only qualifying full breath; minimum-to-minimum with nearest rest-width endpoint match.
breath.resampling: Nearest native frame at equal target phases j/16, round-half-up; no blending, synthesis or endpoint duplication.

transform.resampling: PIL affine bicubic, inverse diagonal 1/scale on both axes; scale about origin
transform.sole_line_definition: Bottommost row of alpha>=128 figure support (includes held equipment); no independent anatomical annotation.
transform.root_anchor_note: Atlas pivot is fixed metadata, not independently inferred anatomy.
transform.scale_selection: Closest sampled single uniform factor to 240/1132 yielding raster height 240 and even alpha-bbox width; see registration_scale_search.json. Initial factor left a half-pixel centre residual.

plate_survival.definition: Border plate survival = fraction satisfying G>210,R<45,B<45 in 10px border; also counts those keyed pixels retaining alpha>0 and alpha>=128 after frozen matte.
